_comment: Sample portfolio of synthetic derivatives on the line-movement underlying delta_p. Strikes are in implied-probability units. Quantity > 0 is long (premium paid); < 0 is short (premium received). Entry prices are approximate fair values from the Python pricing study. This book mirrors the study's optimal derivative-augmented strategy: short volatility (straddle/strangle) funding long directional calls.
name: Synthetic Line-Movement Book

instrument.description: Call on delta_p struck at +0.02 - long upside in line drift.
Call on delta_p struck at +0.03 - cheaper, deeper OTM upside.
At-the-money straddle - short to harvest the volatility risk premium.
Strangle: short OTM put at -0.04 and OTM call at +0.04.
Bull call spread: long call at +0.02, short call at +0.06.
Butterfly centred at +0.05 - long a pinning view on moderate drift.
